How many rolls for 5 specific attributes?
The total expected number of rolls to get all five specific attributes (by repeatedly rolling each slot until you get the desired attribute for it, without duplicates) would be:
So, on average, you would expect to perform around 140 rolls to get your desired set of five unique attributes.
How many rolls for 5 specific attributes AND all with highest value?
The expected number of rolls for a single slot to get your desired specific attribute with a high stat is 90.

We need to account for the fact that once an attribute is obtained, it cannot appear again. The probability of getting it on any given roll for the next slot is 1/29 × 1/3 = 1/87. Expected rolls is 87.
E(total rolls for 5 specific high stat attributes)≈ 90+87+84+81+78 = 420
So, on average, you would expect to perform around 420 rolls to get your specific set of 5 attributes, and for each of those attributes to have the highest stat.
This is just based on probabilities, so the actual number of rolls might be much higher or (if you're lucky - much lower)
Advice is to use normal reforge stones for the first 2 attributes and the family reforge stones for the last 3 that you want
Applying 3 bonuses of the same reforge family unlocks a reforge family bonus:
the more of the same family bonus you have on your gear pieces the higher the proc chance and the lower the cooldown
If you have more than 3 bonuses of the same family on a gear piece, the effect is increased by 10% (this is per piece, so if you use 4 Barrier Reforges on all 8 pieces,
the shield would than be 280%. If you use all 5 Barrier Reforges, the shield would be 360%.

column2: How to transfer an awakened slot to another slot?
1. select the gear piece and select "socket gem" and remove your rank 4 legendary gem (just a precaution so it does not get lost in nirvana)
2. equip another piece of gear that you can salvage into the awakened slot, so you dont have to salvage your equipped item. choose "transfer ranks" when asked
3. re-equip your original piece of gear BUT THIS TIME choose "equip but dont transfer"
4. you should now have a piece of gear in your inventory with an upgraded rank and awakening
5. go to the blacksmith and choose "transfer rank". transfer the rank (NOT THE AWAKENING) from your inventory piece to the equipped piece
6. go to Zamina and Extract the Essence of the awakened gear in your inventory
7. you should now have a dawning echo in your inventory
8. slot your rank 4 gem into the NEW item slot that you want to awaken
9. awaken the slot at the master jeweler
10. save your loadout in the armory
When you place a rank 4 Legendary Gem inside on of your Gear Pieces you can awaken the gear piece at the Master Jeweler
You will need to buy a Dawning Echo to do so (with Orbs / Platinum)
Legendary Items will get an extra bonus associated with the skill essence they modify.
Along with the above bonuses you can also unlock offensive or defensive bonus % modifiers (depending on the type of Gem you awakened) and
more resonance, when you place Gems inside and upgrade them.

column2: Charms can be powerful damage modifiers, since they can increase your damage by up to 10%.
However the process of obtaining / upgrading charms is heavily RNG based and buying skill stones off the market is an inefficient way to spend your platinum.
Each upgrade adds a new skill (from any class) to the charm. The % modifier can range between 2% and 10%.
After a charm has reached level 5 it can no longer be upgraded but it can be used to create a "Skill Stone". This "extracation" costs 500 Platinum.
Chances to roll higher % damage multipliers can be found below. In one of the latest patches it was said that the chance to roll a 10% damage multiplier has been increased

Chance to hit 1 skill 
from your class

from your class

Chance to reroll a skill 
from a skill stone (=1/5)
If you complete your daily Codex Activities and buy the weekly 3 charms from the HILT Vendor you have enough enchanted dust to create 1 Skill Stone / week (+500 Platinum).
If you buy the battle pass each month and you occasionally get the extra 1 charm from the time-limited offer at the HILT Vendor you can create another 1-2 Skill Stones each month.
You can sell skill stones on the market (max price is 2500 Platinum) or
If the skill stone contains a skill you want to use, you can use the skill stone to "enrich" another Rank 5 charm (typically the one that your character is using).
If the skill stone contains a skill your current charm already has, you can try to "enrich" your charm with the skill stone to upgrade the % modifier.
During the imbuing or "enrichment" process you can choose a skill on your charm that you want to replace with 1 of the 5 skills on the skill stone.
The process is total RNG. You can then choose if you want to keep your old skill on the charm or replace it with the newly rolled skill.
It is possible to "upgrade" the % modifier on your charm by using a skill stone with the same skill and hoping that the roll hits a higher % modifier.
Since the process of rolling skills on the charms and enrichment is all total rng and it is not efficient to buy skill stones on the market for platinum,
the whole mechanic is nothing you should focus on too much.
1. Only use skills on your charms that do damage. Charms only modify the damage that is done by the skill itself, it does not modify the damage of a buff that the skill offers.
2. The most valuable skill on your charm is the primary attack modifier, since it is almost always useful.
If you get a charm with a primary attack skill (for any class) it might be worth considering selling the skill stone, because everyone will be looking for those on the market.
3. If you plan to upgrade your % modifier on your charms look for the cheapest skill stones on the market (you can sort by price).
These can change with each round of new essences

column2: In order to utilize the enchanting system, all eight primary equipment slots must be upgraded to Rank 30.
The enchanting process itself allows players to reroll only one of the existing magic affixes on a legendary item at a time.
The first re-roll on each piece costs 50000 Gold and 100 Dust. Each subsequent roll costs 100000 and 200 Dust, so rolling multiple times becomes expensive quickly
Class Affixes and Helliquary Affixes cannot be re-rolled.
Legendary Affixes can also be re-rolled, but the re-roll costs 10 Terror Essences and is random, so the cost is pretty high
In order to craft equipment you need to farm the newly introduced crafting materials:
Select the equipment slot you wish to craft a legendary item for (Head, Shoulders, Torso, Legs, Main-Hand, or Off-Hand).
You will get an Equipment Piece with random 2-3 Attributes and 2-4 Magic Affixes. It will have 1 random Class Affix (see Class Affixes to check what Affix can roll on what Gear Slot)
Only Fine Crafting guarantees a triple-stat item and lets you choose the Class Affix.
The primary advantage of utilizing the Fine Craft system lies in the ability to select one class-specific affix for the crafted legendary item. This targeted approach significantly
reduces the element of random chance in obtaining crucial class affixes that can define character builds. Items created through Fine Crafting are guaranteed to possess
3 main attributes; however, the number of additional magic affixes will vary between two and four.
When craftina skill stone you will get guaranteed 3 random class skills on your skill stone.
Crafted Skill Stones cannot be sold.
